\footnotesize
Hyperparameters are parsed from the per-model \texttt{*\_report.json} files, which sit at inconsistent depths and are located by globbing beneath \texttt{<DATASET>/<FAMILY>/}. Where a report carries no \texttt{parameters} block, the values are transcribed instead from the corresponding notebook's constructor call, read as source without executing it; the \texttt{*\_hyperparameters\_source} columns of the companion CSV record which of the two each cell came from. \texttt{train\_time\_mean} / \texttt{train\_time\_std} are the DP training times at $\varepsilon=1.0$ from \texttt{consolidated\_data.csv}; \texttt{std\_train\_time\_s} is the non-private time. Library versions (NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, Opacus, diffprivlib) are not recorded in any per-model report; they are taken from the exact (\texttt{==}) pins resolved in this repository's \texttt{pyproject.toml} / \texttt{uv.lock}. \texttt{pyproject.toml} pins only a floor on the interpreter (\texttt{requires-python = ">=3.13"}), and \texttt{uv.lock} resolves against both cp313 and cp314 wheel sets without recording which one actually ran; \texttt{version\_python} is recorded as 3.13 on the authors' direct confirmation of the interpreter used. The full hyperparameter strings are in the companion CSV.
\end{tablenotes}
